speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old woman. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The 11-year history of chronic cough with copious, foul-smelling, purulent sputum in a non-smoker is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis rather than simple chronic bronchitis. To confirm this, I need to see a Chest_X-Ray and request a CT_Chest scan to visualize the airway dilation and bronchial wall thickening.
